## What you should be able to do tonight

- Plot every drill score and arithmetic time from the whole year and state what improved and what plateaued.
- Have the capstone materials complete and verified before tomorrow.

:::

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}

:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> One last full mock: fifteen minutes, mixed, cold, recorded. Compare against day 350 and day 357.
:::
